captions.text: Steer at one fixed early step, k ≈ 3–8: around the window, which sits at the same place in every phase, and where RL gains are high and flat.
Drop the learned per-chunk choice of step. The window does not move, and the critic cannot tell an adaptive agent which step to use.
Longer RL runs (8–9M env steps) agree: fixed k = 3 or 5 reach 0.91–0.92, against 0.87 for adaptive k (run before its entropy fix) and 0.82 at k = 0.
The main limit: the simulator test changed only the first chunk. That full test has not been run.
